Summary: DermGPT is described as an AI-powered dermatology chatbot intended to improve clinic productivity and streamline dermatology workflows by providing cited answers from curated dermatology literature.

Intended Use & Workflow: Intended as an assistant for dermatologists and staff to support practice management tasks and access dermatology knowledge; not a stand-alone decision maker or replacement for medical care/decision-making.
Primary Intended Users: Dermatologists and dermatology staff (RNs, MAs, ancillary staff); some sources describe broader audiences, but primary positioning is clinical workflow support.
